name: broderick
status: SEED v0 — extrapolated from source panels 2026-06-11; refine before render
look: Grayscale hand-drawn digital memoir comic with two deliberate spot-color breaks: ornate green script on the title card and bright red blood accents in the final panel. Caricature faces are the most rendered element — dense pen texture in the beard, tonal gray washes, heavy black glasses — over looser gray-washed bodies and sketchy environments (scribbled weeds, pegboard, silhouetted industrial skyline). Bordered panels with white rounded caption boxes top-anchored, bold italic hand caps with size/weight shifts for emphasis. Ghosted pale figures used for remembered presences.
register: absurdist deadpan comedy register; the joke is in the timing and the flatness of the delivery — here applied to rueful autobiographical memory

ink_black.usage: contours, lettering, glasses frames, caption box borders

wash_light_gray.usage: garments, sky band, ghosted memory figure of the teacher

wash_mid_gray.usage: work shirt, road sign plate, road surface, shadows

silhouette_black.usage: industrial skyline, smoke columns, evolution-of-man title figures

title_green.usage: ornate curling script of the series title only

blood_red.usage: final-panel spot accent — bleeding fingertip, smeared roller, bench drips; the only color in the scene

casting_canon.schpiegler: 50s, heavyset with thick neck and slabby shoulders; bald on top, full graying beard, thick black rectangular glasses, perpetual sweat droplets; gray button-up work shirt with pen and pencil in breast pocket; permanently enraged hard-ass, bellowed ultimatums and mocking impressions; appears ghosted pale-gray as a remembered glowering bust.
casting_canon.narrator: 12-13, 7th grade, skinny; long straight hair past the shoulders, pointed nose; hand-lettered JETHRO TULL t-shirt in class, plain crew-neck sweater on project day; faint smirk under fire, dismay at his own bleeding finger; wry retrospective caption voice.
casting_canon.classmate: 12-13, slight; dark rounded bob; plain light shirt; wary frown, hands kept flat on the bench.

negatives: photorealistic, photograph, 3d render, cgi, cinematic lighting, lens flare, gradient shading, airbrush, watermark, signature, garbled text, malformed lettering, extra fingers, full-color scenes, saturated color, halftone dots, screentone, anime style, chibi proportions, speech balloons, clean vector linework, painted backgrounds, real hate-group insignia or symbols

continuity.comics: Lock each recurring character with a model sheet (front/side/expression strip) before generating strips; restate the full character description in every panel prompt.
continuity.video: Use the locked panel art as the first frame; restate the full character description in every shot.

legal_rule: Specify every character by age, origin, build, wardrobe, and affect only — never by likeness to a real public figure. If a render resembles a real person, regenerate.

failure_fixes.drifts_photoreal: Add: grayscale hand-drawn comic illustration, pen-textured caricature face, gray wash body, sketchy background, no photographic rendering, no 3d.
failure_fixes.lettering_garbled: Generate art without text; add hand-lettering and caption boxes in post or via dedicated lettering pass.
failure_fixes.drifts_color: Add: strictly grayscale except the designated spot accent (red blood in the final panel, green title script); no other color anywhere.
failure_fixes.spot_color_spreads: If red or green leaks into other elements, regenerate; spot color is one motif per designated panel only.
